overview: You wrote tomorrow as the Rose, Long Meg, to the yard. The moon was already printed full. You did not write a receipt, and you did not put the letter into the almanac.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the Rose into Friday and did not write a sum.

assets.name: Long Meg of Westminster
assets.disposition: Set the Rose and Long Meg for tomorrow's yard

summary: Set the Rose and Long Meg for tomorrow's yard
